name.local: デジタルヘルスファンド大阪投資事業有限責任組合

strategy.thesis: Public-private investment fund set up by Osaka Prefecture (with Nippon Venture Capital, NVCC, as general partner) as the capital vehicle of Osaka's 'next-generation smart health' startup-creation project, investing mainly in SaMD (software-as-a-medical-device / therapeutic and preventive apps) and other digital-healthcare ventures, backed by LPs including TIS Inc. and NTT DATA Kansai.

summary.en: A ¥2.25B public-private fund established by Osaka Prefecture in 2023 and GP'd by Nippon Venture Capital, dedicated to SaMD and other digital-health startups as the investment arm of Osaka's next-generation smart-health startup program (linked to the Saito biomedical hub).
summary.local: 大阪府が2023年度に設立した22.5億円規模の官民ファンド。日本ベンチャーキャピタル（NVCC）が無限責任組合員を務め、SaMD（治療用アプリ等）を中心にデジタルヘルスケア分野のスタートアップに投資する、大阪府「次世代スマートヘルス」プロジェクトの投資母体。

sources.title: 「デジタルヘルスファンド大阪投資事業有限責任組合」を設立いたしました
